events.address: Bogardus Plaza, 5 Hudson Street, New York, NY 10013
events.what_it_is: A one-day OXO Climate Week Tiny Kitchen activation with complimentary coffee, chef-curated bites, sustainability programming and giveaways.
events.what_is_free: Complimentary coffee and chef-curated bites. Swivel Peelers are available while supplies last; guests who RSVP are entered for a chance to receive a Rapid Brewer, limited to the first 50 guests under the published promotion.
events.caveats: The event is published as open to the public. RSVP is tied to the Rapid Brewer promotional chance rather than established as an admission requirement; giveaways are limited/while supplies last.
events.practical_notes: Thursday Sept. 24, 11 AM–4 PM at Bogardus Plaza in Tribeca.

events.address: The Hub, 115 Bowery, New York, NY 10002
events.what_it_is: Welcome to Chinatown's Test Thursday featuring Kem, a Vietnamese coffee counter concept, with Vietnamese coffee, matcha and pandan waffles available to sample and shop.
events.what_is_free: Samples of classic Vietnamese coffee are explicitly advertised for visitors.
events.caveats: Official host page says the event is open to all and no RSVP is required.
events.practical_notes: Thursday Sept. 24, 11 AM–6 PM at The Hub, 115 Bowery.

events.address: Iconic Magazine Lafayette, 238 Lafayette Street, New York, NY 10012
events.what_it_is: An interactive GU FW26 takeover at Iconic Magazines with a prize wheel, photo opportunities and linked activities at the GU SoHo flagship.
events.what_is_free: The first 50 customers each day at Iconic Magazines can receive a complimentary flower bouquet; the prize wheel offers a chance at a GU gift card. Other offers, including embroidery and a tote, require qualifying purchases.
events.caveats: Open to the public. Some perks require purchases; flower bouquets are limited to the first 50 customers each day and other giveaways/offers are subject to published limits.
events.practical_notes: Sept. 24–27, noon–6 PM daily at 238 Lafayette Street.

events.what_it_is: A one-day Native × Peanuts street cart celebrating the collaboration with product sampling and surprise giveaway moments.
events.what_is_free: Published event descriptions advertise special sample giveaways—one for the visitor and one to give to a friend—plus surprise giveaway moments.
events.caveats: Published as open to the public. Samples and surprise giveaways are limited-time promotional items and should be treated as while-supplies-last even where a quantity is not published.
events.practical_notes: Friday Sept. 25, 9 AM–4 PM, on Broadway between Prince and Houston at 600 Broadway.

events.event_name: UNIQLO World Trade Center Grand Opening
events.what_it_is: UNIQLO's World Trade Center store grand opening week, with opening-week offers and a Sept. 25–27 weekend program including giveaways, breakfast treats, Lady M gift cards for eligible app members, taiko performances and early-access merchandise.
events.what_is_free: Sept. 25–27: first 300 customers in line each day receive a free knot bag with goodies and a free breakfast treat; first 50 eligible UNIQLO App members daily can receive a Lady M gift card. No purchase is necessary for those published giveaways. A separate travel-case gift requires a $99+ purchase.
events.caveats: Walk-in retail opening; no ticket/RSVP is published. Giveaway quantities are limited. UNIQLO says the line may begin as early as 7 AM; the store begins admitting customers at 10 AM Friday/Saturday and 11 AM Sunday. Some perks have app-membership or purchase requirements.
events.practical_notes: Grand opening Sept. 25. Store hours are Mon–Sat 10 AM–8 PM and Sun 11 AM–7 PM. Opening-week offers run Sept. 25–Oct. 1; the special opening-weekend giveaway program runs Sept. 25–27.

events.event_name: SEOUL NOW: The Edited Opening Reception
events.what_it_is: Opening night for the SEOUL NOW: The Edited pop-up, with Korean fashion, K-beauty, accessories, music, drinks, light bites, limited gifts and a Polaroid experience.
events.what_is_free: Eventbrite currently lists the opening reception among free NYC events; the event description advertises drinks, light bites, limited gifts and the Polaroid experience without a purchase requirement.
events.caveats: RSVP is required and space is limited; the organizer says entry is subject to venue capacity. No organizer-selection/approval step is stated, so this is Free RSVP rather than Approval Required.
events.practical_notes: Thursday Sept. 24, 6–9 PM; doors listed at 5:30 PM. The associated YJACK Seoul Now pop-up at the same address runs Sept. 22–Oct. 5, 11 AM–7 PM daily, with opening-night/weekend hours potentially later.
